$comment: GovCon LLM-lane result-file contract v1. One result JSON file per resource, written to the exact result_path named in the task file. Validated DETERMINISTICALLY by sam_labor_demand_extract_90day.py --phase ingest (hand validator — no jsonschema dependency); rows failing validation are counted and never stored. This file is hashed into prompt_hash.

resource_id.description: MUST equal the task file's resource_id.

scope_summary.description: 3-6 sentence factual summary of what the contractor must do/provide. No speculation; null if the selected chunks carry no scope content.

capability_tags.description: Tags from vocabulary.capability_tags ONLY (the controlled vocabulary in the task file). Out-of-vocabulary tags are rejected at ingest.

requirement_value.description: Normalized value (lowercase snake/colon form; reuse vocabulary.value_norm_hints where they fit). For labor_category rows this MUST be a vocabulary.labor_categories member.

mandatory.description: true for shall/must/required language; false for should/may.

source_chunk_ids.description: chunk_ids FROM THE TASK FILE that contain the evidence. Citing a chunk_id not in the task file rejects the row.

evidence_quote.description: VERBATIM quote copied from the cited chunk text. Must substring-match the cited chunks after whitespace normalization or the row is rejected.
